verdict.rationale: Statsig docs explicitly describe scheduled/gradual rollouts to safely deploy new code without redeploying, and deterministic evaluation ensures consistent bucketing across evaluations for the same user given the same gate state. Percentage-based ramping (1%→100%) is a core documented Feature Gate/Scheduled Rollout capability, backed by consistent hashing via deterministic evaluation. missing for 10: explicit mention of percentage granularity/UI slider mechanics and independent hands-on confirmation of ramp behavior.
